observed_defect: Flat prairie lacks visible rolling terrain, breaks strategic camera perspective
design_intent: Create asymmetric, continuous hills and valleys to enhance visual depth and strategic terrain awareness without altering city borders or materials
expected_visual_difference: Visible rolling hills and valleys from strategic camera angle, preserving city and border integrity
mobile_risks: None, all edits are within terrain mesh and do not introduce new geometry or material complexity

actions.reason: Create a broad, asymmetric hill centered at [x: -30, y: 60, z: 0] with radius 30m, elevating terrain to 2.5m, to introduce a visible hill in the strategic view
Create a complementary valley at [x: 30, y: 50, z: 0] with radius 25m, lowering terrain to -1.5m, to contrast with hill and enhance depth
Smooth transition between hill and valley edges to prevent sharp discontinuities and maintain visual continuity
